text:
alex: CI red on master — Bazel ASAN jobs failing on linux-x86 after yesterday's gcc-toolchain rollout. @eng-infra can someone take a quick look?

ci-bot: Job failed: https://ci.redwood.example/job/1234/ (bazel-test-linux-asan)

alex: Failing link error (excerpt):
```
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/10/../../../x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.a: error: undefined reference to `__cxa_bad_typeid'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
``` 
Looks like libstdc++ symbols missing at link time after the toolchain images bumped to gcc-10.2.0.

maria: hmm, we've seen similar with static libstdc++ being pulled in incorrectly. Is this only ASAN? Can you repro locally with `bazel test //... --config=asan`?

alex: yes repros locally in WSL and CI. `bazel build //tooling/launcher` fails when ASAN enabled.

shawn: @alex can you paste `bazel info release` and the exact bazelrc? Also try `--linkopt=-Wl,--no-as-needed` to see if it's a dynamic link ordering issue.

alex: `release 4.2.1` from distro. bazelrc uses `--config=asan` which sets `-fsanitize=address -static-libstdc++`. I tried removing `-static-libstdc++` and the link succeeds.

maria: aha, static libstdc++ + ASAN + new toolchain might be incompatible. The gcc image bump probably replaced libstdc++ with newer C++ ABI. We likely need to switch to dynamic libstdc++ for ASAN builds.

jen: We should avoid changing global build until we confirm. Could we add a temporary workaround in CI to run ASAN builds with `--dynamic_mode=off` or toggle `-static-libstdc++` only for tests that need it? Or pin the toolchain image back to previous container for ASAN CI.

shawn: I can open a bisect PR that runs ASAN with and without `-static-libstdc++` across last two toolchain images to confirm. If that points to the image, we can revert or update images.

alex: filing a quick issue: https://git.internal/redwood/issues/INFRA-782 — test repro + logs attached.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @shawn — https://ci.redwood.example/job/1234/console

maria: For a faster unblock, change: in `bazelrc` under `[asan]` remove `-static-libstdc++` and add a comment. We'll try that in a canary job.

jen: I'll create canary job in CI to run `bazel test //... --config=asan -- //tooling/...` and tag it `canary/asan-no-static-libstdcxx`.

alex: thanks — will watch. If that passes we can roll a quick patch and keep follow-up to reconcile toolchain images properly.

maria: FYI @eng-sre we might need to coordinate image rollbacks if the bisect confirms.

shawn: Opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/abcd1234 (only changes bazelrc for canary)

alex: :thumbsup: Good triage. Keep me posted.
